title: MACH: Machine-Actionable Catalog for Healthcare
description: An open, machine-actionable catalog of open-source healthcare software, AI/ML models, clinical standards, datasets, tooling, and MCP servers — curated for humans, queryable by agents. Every entry is a structured JSON-LD record aligned with established open metadata standards (CodeMeta, MLDCAT-AP, Croissant, DCAT-AP), enabling discovery by hospitals, researchers, governments, and AI agents. Catalog data (entries/) is CC0-1.0 (no rights reserved); pipeline code is Apache-2.0.
notes: This is an early-stage release. Active development is ongoing. A formal versioned release is planned once the schema export pipeline and 50+ entries are complete.
